answer_1.quote: We conduct experiments on Chinese→English (ZH→EN) and German→English (DE→EN) translation. ... We use Transformer-base as our model architecture, and follow ... to train our model with wait-k policies.

answer_2.quote: We use BLEU as the translation quality metric, and Average Lagging (AL) as the latency metric, which measures the lag behind source in terms of the number of source tokens.
